columns.name: UserId
columns.description: Unique user identifier. Removed from this dataset's export by D2L in BDS Major Version 11 (per D2L's official notice, 'Announcing Data Hub Brightspace Data Sets (BDS) Major Version 11'): UserId was dropped as redundant because it's already available on Rubric Assessment BDS. D2L's stated impact: Rubric Assessment Criteria must now be joined with Rubric Assessment on AssessmentId to determine the UserId, and records that used to be differentiated only by UserId are now deduplicated by D2L before export. This column is kept here (not removed) only so existing references to ColumnSchema-by-name don't break, but it is demoted from primary so build-fulldiff/process no longer require it to be present in the incoming file.
columns.versionHistory: 5.6 - Updated PK; override 2026-06-29 - D2L dropped this column from the export, demoted from primary
